rationale: Resolve directional reuse allegations using independent WMATA access maps and recorded OSM topology; preserve source coordinates and uncertainty; no edits to OSM.

record.notes: The Herndon-Monroe Park and Ride is on the SOUTH side of the Dulles corridor in the WMATA map; the earlier north-side characterization was incorrect. Its research reference is 40.8 m from south entrance node 3105651341 and 227.1 m from north node 7432921936. Sharing the south candidate with WMATA-106 is not evidence of a cross-side mismatch. The broad Park and Ride source view has not been established as a separate physical station entrance; do not count it as an additional verified entrance or deduplicate source IDs. Evidence: https://www.wmata.com/content/dam/wmata-com/maps/Rail%20Station%20Vicinity%20Maps/Herndon_vicinity-map.pdf ; https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/3105651341 Recorded geometry evidence: docs/evidence/reston-herndon-2026-10-16.json. Desktop interpretation only; no OSM edit approved.

2026-10-16 desktop match: north-pavilion elevator node 13853418711 is tagged highway=elevator and connects to ground-level footway 1517672541 and bridge-level footway 1517672540 within north pavilion/bridge building 1010702112. WMATA map shows a north-pavilion elevator. The panorama lies 162.9 m away near the road junction. The elevator geometry already exists; level/wheelchair/entrance-tag completeness needs a separate check. Evidence: https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/13853418711 ; https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/1517672540 ; https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/1517672541 ; https://www.wmata.com/content/dam/wmata-com/maps/Rail%20Station%20Vicinity%20Maps/Reston%20Town%20Center_vicinity-map.pdf Directional recheck: this is the north side of the Dulles corridor, between Sunset Hills Road and the northern carriageway. The south-labelled research references for WMATA-173/175 lying closer to this node do not turn it into a south-pavilion elevator. They are inconsistent with the south access description; do not use proximity to transfer identity. Recorded geometry evidence: docs/evidence/reston-herndon-2026-10-16.json. Desktop interpretation only; no OSM edit approved.

Desktop recheck of the south-busbay elevator description: WMATA vicinity map shows a separate south-pavilion elevator. OSM node 13853391339 is highway=elevator, level=0;1, wheelchair=yes, attached to south bridge building 1010702114 and footways 1517654250/1517654251. Its geometry is on the south side of the Dulles corridor. The source research reference is 138.6 m from this south elevator but only 44.6 m from north elevator 13853418711. This is a label/reference-location inconsistency, not a confirmed missing elevator or a match to the north elevator. The panorama itself was not visually verified; whether its coordinate or source label is erroneous remains open. No source coordinate is replaced.
